seoTitle: Scottsdale Unified Calendar 2025–26: Dates, Breaks and PDF
seoDescription: Find Scottsdale Unified’s 2025–26 first day, breaks, early-release dates, conference days, final exams, last day, and official PDF.
heroSummary: Scottsdale Unified students began the 2025–26 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025, and the last day of school was Friday, May 22, 2026. The district calendar lists 180 student instructional days, Fall Break from October 13–17, Winter Break from December 22 through January 2, and Spring Break from March 16–20. The PDF also marks all-grade early releases, conference early releases, and high school final exam early-release dates.
calendarNotes: SUSD’s 2025–26 PDF separates early-release dates by grade and program type. Conference early releases affect elementary/K-8 schools and middle schools on different dates, while high school final exam days are called out separately.
keyDatesSummarySubtitle: The SUSD dates families are most likely to need first
allDatesCoverageNote: This list includes districtwide SUSD student dates, staff preparation days, holidays, recesses, conference early releases, high school final exam early releases, and the last day published on the official district calendar. School-level events, athletics, testing, transportation updates, and exact bell schedules may be published separately by individual schools.
icsHeading: Add the 2025–26 SUSD Dates to Your Calendar
icsDescription: Download an .ics file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. This is a one-time import and will not update automatically if SUSD revises its calendar.
pdfDescription: Open the district’s official calendar PDF.
sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed against the SUSD district calendar page and the official 2025–26 calendar PDF. We checked the first day, last day, recesses, no-school days, early-release labels, final exam windows, board approval date, and student instructional-day total.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF lists 180 student instructional days and is marked Board Approved: May 13, 2025.
The PDF separates all-grade early releases, elementary/K-8 conference early releases, middle school conference early releases, and high school final exam early releases.
The second page of the PDF includes school directory bell schedules; families should verify exact dismissal times with their campus.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Scottsdale Unified start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Scottsdale Unified started the 2025–26 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When was SUSD Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break ran Monday, October 13, through Friday, October 17, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all SUSD early-release days follow the same schedule?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The district calendar separates all-grade early releases, conference early releases, and high school final exam early releases.

calendarFaqs.q: Was the last day of school an early-release day?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Friday, May 22, 2026 was the last day of school and was marked as early release for all grades.

customSections.label: How Scottsdale Unified’s Calendar Works
customSections.content: SUSD’s 2025–26 calendar uses several shortened-day labels. Families should check both the district date and their school’s bell schedule before making pickup or child care plans.

rows: The PDF marks several dates as early release for all grades, including pre-K.
October and spring conference windows are split between elementary/K-8 schools and middle schools.
December 17–19 and May 20–22 are high school final exam early-release windows.
September 23, October 2, and April 3 are separate no-school dates outside the main breaks.
The PDF includes campus class schedules and early-release times.
